pasteBlockedSecureField.title: Not pasted into a password field
pasteBlockedSecureField.description: A secure text field had focus. The transcript is in History.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste
reliablePaste.description: Restore your clipboard only after the target app has read the transcript, and restore every item and format exactly. Turn off to use the legacy timed paste as a fallback. macOS and Windows only.

blockSecureFields.title: Never paste into password fields
blockSecureFields.description: When a secure text field has focus (or macOS Secure Input is on), skip the paste and show a notice instead. The transcript stays in History.

datasetLogging.title: Log dictations for training & analysis
datasetLogging.description: Keep every dictation's raw model output, cleaned text, LLM text, timings, pauses and frontmost app in the local dataset, with its audio. Export with `handy --export-dataset <dir>`. Nothing leaves this Mac.

verbatim.title: Verbatim transcription
verbatim.description: Prompt Whisper models with filler words so ums, uhs and false starts are kept in the raw transcript. Filler removal still cleans the pasted text. Whisper models only.

verbatimPrompt.title: Verbatim prompt
verbatimPrompt.description: Initial prompt given to Whisper in verbatim mode. Leave empty for the default.

llmTimeout.title: LLM timeout
llmTimeout.description: If the LLM (e.g. LM Studio) is unreachable or takes longer than this, the rule-cleaned text is pasted instead and a small notice is shown. Dictation never fails because the LLM is down.

insights.title: Speech insights
insights.subtitle: From verbatim transcripts where the background worker has made them, otherwise from your raw dictations. Computed locally.
insights.empty: No dictations in this range yet.

coaching.title: Weekly coaching note
coaching.description: Sends this week's and last week's aggregate numbers (never your transcripts) to your coaching LLM (local LM Studio by default).

insights.basis: {{verbatim}} of {{total}} dictations measured from verbatim transcripts.
insights.basisEstimate: For the rest, fillers Parakeet dropped are estimated from speech time (dashed lines; calibrated on {{samples}} verbatim dictations).
insights.frozen: Some periods keep results from older metric definitions (marked ▼ on the charts).

breaks.definitions: Metric definition changed ({{detail}}): not a change in how you speak.

profiles.title: App profiles
profiles.description: Matched on the frontmost app's bundle id (a trailing * matches a prefix). "Always" runs the LLM with the profile's prompt even on the plain shortcut, when post-processing is enabled. Recently used apps are suggested in the bundle id field.
profiles.name: Name

panel.title: Verbatim analysis
panel.disabled: Verbatim analysis is off. Turn it on in Settings → Advanced to count the fillers Parakeet drops.

settings.groupDescription: Re-transcribes your recordings with a verbatim model (CrisperWhisper, CC BY-NC 4.0) when you're not using the Mac, so Insights can count fillers. Fully local; never slows down dictation.
settings.macOnly: The background service runs on macOS only.
settings.missing: No worker found at {{dir}}. Set the worker folder below.
settings.noUv: uv was not found. Install it (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) or set its path below.

enabled.title: Background verbatim analysis
enabled.description: Installs a launchd agent that runs nightly and at login, and lets Handy start a run when you've been idle. Turning it off removes the agent and keeps all data.

schedule.title: Nightly run
schedule.description: When the nightly run starts. A missed run (Mac off or asleep) catches up later.

idle.title: Run when idle
idle.description: Start a run when you haven't touched the Mac for a while and recordings are waiting. It stops as soon as you're back.

idleMinutes.title: Idle for (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: How long without keyboard or mouse input before a run starts.

battery.title: Skip on battery
battery.description: Don't run (and stop) while on battery. Low Power Mode, thermal throttling and low disk/memory always skip.

budget.title: Time budget
budget.description: Nightly runs stop by a set time and continue on the next run.

stopBy.title: Stop by
stopBy.description: Nightly runs end at this time.

autoUpdate.title: Update the worker automatically
autoUpdate.description: After you pull a new version of the fork, re-sync the worker's environment (uv sync) without asking.

retention.title: Audio retention
retention.description: Compress old recordings losslessly and delete very old audio, only when a verified verbatim transcript exists. Off by default; shows a preview first.

retentionDays.title: Retention rule (days)
retentionDays.description: Compress WAVs to FLAC after this many days; delete audio after this many days if a verified verbatim transcript exists. 0 = never.

coaching.title: Weekly coaching note
coaching.description: Every Monday, sends last week's aggregate metrics (never transcripts) to your coaching LLM and keeps the note on the Insights page.

paths.title: Worker and uv paths
paths.description: Leave empty for the fork's analysis-worker/ folder and uv's usual install location. Use absolute paths.

retentionPreview.title: Retention preview
retentionPreview.description: What the next retention pass would do with the current rule.
retentionPreview.compress_one: Compress {{count}} recording ({{size}}, saves about {{saved}}). Lossless; checked before the WAV is removed.
retentionPreview.compress_other: Compress {{count}} recordings ({{size}}, saves about {{saved}}). Lossless; checked before the WAV is removed.
retentionPreview.delete_one: Delete the audio of {{count}} recording ({{size}}) that has a verified verbatim transcript.
retentionPreview.delete_other: Delete the audio of {{count}} recordings ({{size}}) that have a verified verbatim transcript.
retentionPreview.kept: Kept regardless: {{unprocessed}} without a verbatim transcript, {{unverified}} with an unverified one, {{history}} still in History.
